text: Appeal of Order to Comply (November 12, 2018) for 217 St. George Street.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated November 12, 2018, regarding the property located at 217 St. George Street, Folder No. 18 255246 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 30, 2019.
